text: 1.In principle, applicants should be over the age of 18 and under the age of 30. 2.Applicants must be healthy, both mentally and physically. 3.Applicant should have got the senior school leaving certificate upon registration with CQMU. 4.The applicants for Chinese-medium programs need to have passed the Chinese HSK test with Grade 3 of Elementary Level, or have a statement from their embassy which proves that their secondary education was conducted in Chinese。
